title: cotula longipes
intro: Cotula longipes, commonly known as the New Zealand cotula, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The New Zealand cotula has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential in treating digestive issues, inflammation, and microbial infections, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cotula longipes include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and colds, and its antispasmodic properties, which can aid in reducing muscle spasms and cramps. The bioactive constituents of Cotula longipes include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
